lines.en: Do you keep warm when it is cold?
lines.zh: 天冷的时候，你会注意保暖吗？

patterns.en: What is wrong with you? I have a cold.
patterns.zh: 你怎么了？我感冒了。

patterns.en: What is wrong with you? I have a cough.
patterns.zh: 你怎么了？我咳嗽了。

patterns.en: What is wrong with you? I have a pain in my head.
patterns.zh: 你怎么了？我头疼。

patterns.en: What is wrong with you? I have a pain in my stomach.
patterns.zh: 你怎么了？我肚子疼。

patterns.en: What is wrong with you? I have a bad tooth.
patterns.zh: 你怎么了？我牙疼。

lines.en: I like healthy food.
Fruit is good for my body.
lines.zh: 水果对我的身体有好处。

lines.en: I have an apple every morning.
lines.zh: 我每天早上吃一个苹果。

lines.en: Milk makes my bones strong.
lines.zh: 牛奶让我的骨头更结实。

lines.en: There is fish and rice on the table.
My mother is cooking green vegetables.
lines.zh: 妈妈正在炒绿色的蔬菜。

lines.en: Cake is sweet, but sugar is bad for my teeth.
lines.zh: 蛋糕很甜，但是糖对我的牙齿不好。

lines.en: I am strong because I have good food.
lines.zh: 我很强壮，因为我吃健康的食物。

lines.en: Do you like healthy food?

patterns.en: Is milk good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 牛奶对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is fruit good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 水果对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is fish good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 鱼对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is sugar good for you? No, it isn't.
patterns.zh: 糖对你有好处吗？不，没有好处。

patterns.en: Are vegetables good for you? Yes, they are.
patterns.zh: 蔬菜对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

lines.en: It is Saturday morning.
My family is cleaning the house.
lines.zh: 我们全家正在打扫房子。

lines.en: My father is washing the windows.
My mother is cleaning the floor.
My sister is putting her books on the shelf.
lines.zh: 妹妹在把她的书放到书架上。

lines.en: And I am washing the cups and plates.
There is water on my shirt, but I don't mind.
lines.zh: 我的衬衫上有水，但是我不在意。

lines.en: Now our house is clean and bright.
lines.zh: 现在我们的房子又干净又明亮。

lines.en: I am happy to help my family.
Do you help at home?

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I wash the plates.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我洗盘子。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I clean the floor.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我拖地。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I make my bed.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我整理床铺。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I give the plants water.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我给植物浇水。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I put my books on the shelf.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我把书放到书架上。

lines.en: My house is in a small town.
There is a long river in my town.
lines.zh: 我的小城里有一条长长的河。

lines.en: There are boats on the river.
There is a school near my house.
There is a market by the station.
My mother is getting fruit and fish there.
lines.zh: 妈妈正在那里买水果和鱼。

lines.en: We have a library and a hospital.
lines.zh: 我们这里有图书馆和医院。

lines.en: My town is small, but it is beautiful.
lines.zh: 我的小城很小，但是很美。

lines.en: I love my town.
What is in your town?

patterns.en: Is there a library in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有图书馆吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a hospital in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有医院吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a market in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有市场吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a station in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有车站吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a zoo in your town? No, there isn't.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有动物园吗？不，没有。

lines.en: I have a pen friend.
His name is Tom.
He is from London.
He is as old as me.
He goes to a school near the sea.
lines.zh: 他在海边的一所学校上学。

lines.en: He likes football and music.
Now I am writing a letter to him.
I am putting a picture of my family in it.
lines.zh: 我在信里放了一张我家人的照片。

lines.en: I hope he will be happy to get my letter.
lines.zh: 我希望他收到我的信会很开心。

lines.en: Do you have a pen friend?

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes music.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢音乐。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes football.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢足球。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes reading.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢读书。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes animals.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢动物。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? She likes painting.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？她喜欢画画。

lines.en: Last Sunday was a happy day.
lines.zh: 上个星期天是快乐的一天。

lines.en: The weather was warm and bright.
I went to the park with my family.
We walked by the river.
My father played ball with me.
My mother had bread and fruit for us.
lines.zh: 妈妈给我们带了面包和水果。

lines.en: I saw some fish in the water.
We were in the sun all morning.
lines.zh: 我们整个上午都在晒太阳。

lines.en: We were tired, but we were very happy.
lines.zh: 我们很累，但是非常开心。

lines.en: What did you do last Sunday?
lines.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I played ball.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我玩了球。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I went to the park.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我去了公园。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I went swimming.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我去游泳了。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I cooked with my father.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我和爸爸一起做饭了。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I painted a picture.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我画了一幅画。

lines.en: Last week, we went to a farm.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我们去了一个农场。

lines.en: The farm was green and quiet.
There were cows, pigs and sheep.
I gave some grass to a cow.
lines.zh: 我给一头奶牛喂了些草。

lines.en: The little pigs were very dirty.
We took apples from the trees.
The apples were red and sweet.
The farmer put me on his horse.
lines.zh: 农场主把我抱上了他的马。

lines.en: It was a great day!
Have you been to a farm?

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some cows.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些奶牛。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some pigs.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些猪。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some sheep.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些羊。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some goats.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些山羊。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw a horse.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一匹马。

lines.en: Spring Festival is our New Year.
Last Spring Festival, we went to see my grandma.
lines.zh: 去年春节，我们去看望了奶奶。

lines.en: All my family were there.
We put red paper on the doors.
My grandma and mother made dumplings.
At night, we had a great meal together.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们一起吃了一顿丰盛的大餐。

lines.en: There were fireworks in the sky.
My grandpa gave me some money in red paper.
I was very happy that night.
Happy New Year to you!

patterns.en: What did you do at Spring Festival? I made dumplings.
patterns.zh: 春节你做了什么？我包了饺子。

patterns.en: What did you do at Spring Festival? I had dumplings.
patterns.zh: 春节你做了什么？我吃了饺子。

patterns.en: What did you do at Spring Festival? I had a great meal.
patterns.zh: 春节你做了什么？我吃了一顿大餐。

patterns.en: What did you do at Spring Festival? I went to see my grandma.
patterns.zh: 春节你做了什么？我去看望了奶奶。

patterns.en: What did you do at Spring Festival? I put red paper on the door.
patterns.zh: 春节你做了什么？我在门上贴了红纸。

lines.en: My best day was my birthday last year.
lines.zh: 我最棒的一天是去年的生日。

lines.en: My friends came to my house.
My mother made a beautiful cake for me.
lines.zh: 妈妈为我做了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

lines.en: We had the cake and some fruit.
lines.zh: 我们吃了蛋糕和一些水果。

lines.en: We played in the garden and laughed.
lines.zh: 我们在花园里玩耍、欢笑。

lines.en: My friends gave me some presents.
lines.zh: 朋友们送给我一些礼物。

lines.en: My present from my father was a camera.
lines.zh: 爸爸送给我的礼物是一台照相机。

lines.en: At night, I was tired but very happy.
lines.zh: 晚上，我很累，但是非常开心。

lines.en: It was my best day ever!
What was your best day?
lines.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？

patterns.en: What was your best day? It was my birthday.
patterns.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？是我的生日。

patterns.en: What was your best day? It was my first day at school.
patterns.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？是我上学的第一天。

patterns.en: What was your best day? It was a day at the sea.
patterns.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？是在海边的一天。

patterns.en: What was your best day? It was a day on the farm.
patterns.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？是在农场的一天。

patterns.en: What was your best day? It was a day in the snow.
patterns.zh: 你最棒的一天是哪一天？是在雪地里玩的一天。

lines.en: When I was small, I could not walk.
My mother had me in her arms all day.
lines.zh: 妈妈整天把我抱在怀里。

lines.en: I could not talk, but I could cry.
lines.zh: 我不会说话，但是我会哭。

lines.en: When I cried, my father played music for me.
lines.zh: 我一哭，爸爸就给我放音乐。

lines.en: I had a little red ball.
I liked milk and soft rice.
lines.zh: 我喜欢牛奶和软软的米饭。

lines.en: Now I am older and taller.
lines.zh: 现在我长大了，也长高了。

lines.en: I can walk, run, talk and swim.
lines.zh: 我会走，会跑，会说话，还会游泳。

lines.en: But I still love my mother and father very much.
lines.zh: 但是我仍然非常爱我的爸爸妈妈。

lines.en: What were you like when you were small?

patterns.en: When you were small, could you walk? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会走路吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you talk? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会说话吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you swim? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会游泳吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you cry? Yes, I could.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会哭吗？是的，我会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you smile? Yes, I could.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会笑吗？是的，我会。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Today I want to talk about my dream job.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈我的梦想职业。

lines.en: I want to be a doctor when I grow up.
lines.zh: 长大后我想当一名医生。

lines.en: Doctors help people who are ill.
Last year, my grandma was very ill.
lines.zh: 去年，我的奶奶病得很重。

lines.en: A kind doctor looked after her every day.
lines.zh: 一位好心的医生每天照顾她。

lines.en: Then she got well again.
So I want to help people like that doctor.
lines.zh: 所以我想像那位医生一样帮助别人。

lines.en: I will study hard to be a good doctor.
lines.zh: 我会努力学习，成为一名好医生。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I want to be a doctor because I want to help people.
patterns.zh: 我想当医生，因为我想帮助别人。

patterns.en: I want to be a teacher because I love children.
patterns.zh: 我想当老师，因为我喜欢孩子。

patterns.en: I want to be a farmer because I love plants.
patterns.zh: 我想当农民，因为我喜欢植物。

patterns.en: I want to be a cook because I like making good food.
patterns.zh: 我想当厨师，因为我喜欢做好吃的饭菜。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
The summer holiday is coming.
Let me tell you about my holiday plans.
lines.zh: 让我来说说我的假期计划。

lines.en: First, I am going to visit my grandparents in the country.
lines.zh: 首先，我要去乡下看望爷爷奶奶。

lines.en: They have a garden with many fruit trees.
lines.zh: 他们有一个园子，里面有很多果树。

lines.en: Then I am going to learn to swim.
I will read ten good books.
If the weather is good, we will go to the beach.
lines.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去海边。

lines.en: If it rains, we will stay at home and play games.
lines.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里玩游戏。

lines.en: I think it will be my best summer ever!
lines.zh: 我想这会是我过得最棒的一个夏天！

lines.en: What are you going to do this holiday?
lines.zh: 这个假期你打算做什么呢？

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to visit my grandparents.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要去看望爷爷奶奶。

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to learn to swim.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要学游泳。

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to read ten books.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要读十本书。

patterns.en: If the weather is good, we will go to the beach.
patterns.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去海边。

patterns.en: If it rains, we will stay at home and play games.
patterns.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里玩游戏。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
Do you like the city or the country?
Some people like the city, but I like the country better.
lines.zh: 有些人喜欢城市，但我更喜欢乡村。

lines.en: First, the air in the country is cleaner.
lines.zh: 首先，乡村的空气更干净。

lines.en: There are green fields, tall trees and clear rivers.
lines.zh: 那里有绿色的田野、高高的树和清澈的河流。

lines.en: Second, the country is quieter than the city.
lines.zh: 其次，乡村比城市更安静。

lines.en: At night, I can see many stars in the sky.
lines.zh: 晚上，我能看到天上有很多星星。

lines.en: Of course, the city has big shops and fast trains.
lines.zh: 当然，城市里有大商店和快速的火车。

lines.en: But I think life in the country is happier.
lines.zh: 但我觉得乡村的生活更快乐。

lines.en: That is why I love the country.
lines.zh: 这就是我爱乡村的原因。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I think the country is quieter than the city.
patterns.zh: 我觉得乡村比城市更安静。

patterns.en: I think the air in the country is cleaner than in the city.
patterns.zh: 我觉得乡村的空气比城市的更干净。

patterns.en: I think the city is busier than the country.
patterns.zh: 我觉得城市比乡村更热闹。

patterns.en: I think the shops in the city are bigger than in the country.
patterns.zh: 我觉得城市的商店比乡村的更大。

patterns.en: I like the country better because it is green and quiet.
patterns.zh: 我更喜欢乡村，因为那里绿色又安静。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
Which season do you like best?
For me, autumn is the best season.
lines.zh: 对我来说，秋天是最好的季节。

lines.en: It is cooler than summer and warmer than winter.
lines.zh: 它比夏天凉快，比冬天暖和。

lines.en: The sky is blue, and the leaves turn red and yellow.
lines.zh: 天空蓝蓝的，树叶变成了红色和黄色。

lines.en: Apples and oranges are ready to eat in autumn.
lines.zh: 秋天，苹果和橙子都熟了。

lines.en: My family often goes for a walk in the park.
lines.zh: 我们一家人常常去公园散步。

lines.en: We pick up beautiful leaves and make pictures with them.
lines.zh: 我们捡来漂亮的树叶，用它们拼成图画。

lines.en: Spring is lovely, but autumn is more colorful.
lines.zh: 春天很可爱，但秋天更加多彩。

lines.en: So autumn is the season I love most.
lines.zh: 所以秋天是我最爱的季节。

lines.en: What about you?

patterns.en: I like autumn best because it is cool.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢秋天，因为天气凉爽。

patterns.en: I like spring best because the flowers are beautiful.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为花儿很美。

patterns.en: I like summer best because I can swim.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢夏天，因为我可以游泳。

patterns.en: I like winter best because I can play in the snow.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢冬天，因为我可以在雪里玩。

patterns.en: Autumn is cooler than summer.
patterns.zh: 秋天比夏天凉快。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Do you like reading? I do!
Today I want to tell you why I love reading.
lines.zh: 今天我想告诉大家我为什么爱读书。

lines.en: First, books take me to new places.
lines.zh: 首先，书带我去新的地方。

lines.en: In a book, I can go to the bottom of the sea or to the moon.
lines.zh: 在书里，我可以去海底，也可以去月球。

lines.en: Second, books help me learn new words.
lines.zh: 其次，书帮我学习新单词。

lines.en: My English is getting better because I read every day.
lines.zh: 因为我每天读书，我的英语越来越好。

lines.en: Third, reading makes me happy.
When I feel sad, a good story makes me smile.
lines.zh: 当我难过时，一个好故事能让我露出笑容。

lines.en: Every night, I read for twenty minutes before bed.
lines.zh: 每天晚上睡觉前，我都读二十分钟书。

lines.en: I think books are my best friends.
lines.zh: 我觉得书是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I love reading because books take me to new places.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为书带我去新的地方。

patterns.en: I love reading because books help me learn new words.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为书帮我学习新单词。

patterns.en: I love reading because stories make me happy.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为故事让我快乐。

patterns.en: If we read every day, we will learn a lot.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天读书，就会学到很多。

patterns.en: I think reading a book is better than watching TV.
patterns.zh: 我觉得读书比看电视更好。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
Let me tell you about a person I admire.
lines.zh: 让我来说说一个我敬佩的人。

lines.en: She is my mother.
My mother is a nurse in a hospital.
lines.zh: 我妈妈是一家医院的护士。

lines.en: She gets up early and comes back late.
Her work is very hard, but she is kind and patient.
lines.zh: 她的工作很辛苦，但她和蔼又耐心。

lines.en: Last winter, I had a bad cold.
lines.zh: 去年冬天，我得了重感冒。

lines.en: She stayed with me all night and made soup for me.
lines.zh: 她整夜陪着我，还给我做了汤。

lines.en: She helps our neighbors when they need help.
lines.zh: 邻居需要帮助时，她会去帮忙。

lines.en: She says to me, "Be kind to others."
I want to be like her when I grow up.
lines.zh: 长大后我想成为像她一样的人。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I admire my mother because she is kind.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的妈妈，因为她很善良。

patterns.en: I admire my father because he is brave.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的爸爸，因为他很勇敢。

patterns.en: I admire my teacher because she is patient.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的老师，因为她很有耐心。

patterns.en: I admire my grandpa because he works hard.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的爷爷，因为他工作很努力。

patterns.en: I want to be as kind as my mother.
patterns.zh: 我想像妈妈一样善良。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Today I want to talk about saving water.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈节约用水。

lines.en: Water is very important to us.
People, animals and plants all need water.
lines.zh: 人、动物和植物都需要水。

lines.en: But in some places, there is not enough clean water.
lines.zh: 但在一些地方，干净的水并不够用。

lines.en: So we must not waste it.
lines.zh: 所以我们一定不能浪费水。

lines.en: First, we should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
lines.zh: 首先，刷牙时我们应该关掉水龙头。

lines.en: Then, we can take shorter showers.
lines.zh: 然后，我们可以缩短洗澡的时间。

lines.en: We can also use the water from washing fruit for the flowers.
lines.zh: 我们还可以用洗水果的水来浇花。

lines.en: If everyone saves a little water, we will save a lot.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都节约一点水，我们就能节约很多。

lines.en: Let's start today!
Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: If we turn off the tap, we will save water.
patterns.zh: 如果我们关掉水龙头，就能节约用水。

patterns.en: If we take shorter showers, we will save water.
patterns.zh: 如果我们缩短洗澡时间，就能节约用水。

patterns.en: If we use less water, we will help the earth.
patterns.zh: 如果我们少用水，就能帮助地球。

patterns.en: We should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
patterns.zh: 刷牙时我们应该关掉水龙头。

patterns.en: Saving water is easier than you think.
patterns.zh: 节约用水比你想象的更容易。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
Do you love animals? I do!
Animals are our friends.
Like us, they can feel pain and fear.
lines.zh: 它们和我们一样，也会感到疼痛和害怕。

lines.en: Last week, I saw a little cat in the rain.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我在雨里看到一只小猫。

lines.en: It was cold and hungry.
My brother and I gave it some milk and a warm box.
lines.zh: 我和哥哥给了它一些牛奶和一个暖和的箱子。

lines.en: Now it is happy and healthy in our house.
lines.zh: 现在它在我们家里过得又快乐又健康。

lines.en: We should be kind to animals.
First, we should never hurt them.
lines.zh: 首先，我们永远不应该伤害它们。

lines.en: Second, if we have a pet, we must take good care of it.
lines.zh: 其次，如果我们养宠物，就一定要好好照顾它。

lines.en: Let's make the world a better place for animals!
lines.zh: 让我们把世界变成动物们更美好的地方！

patterns.en: We should be kind to animals because they are our friends.
patterns.zh: 我们应该善待动物，因为它们是我们的朋友。

patterns.en: We should never hurt animals because they feel pain.
patterns.zh: 我们永远不应该伤害动物，因为它们会感到疼痛。

patterns.en: If we have a pet, we should give it food every day.
patterns.zh: 如果我们养宠物，就应该每天喂它。

patterns.en: If we see a hungry cat, we can give it some milk.
patterns.zh: 如果我们看到一只饥饿的猫，可以给它一些牛奶。

patterns.en: If we see a lost dog, we can ask a grown-up for help.
patterns.zh: 如果我们看到一只走失的狗，可以请大人帮忙。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
My favorite story is The Lion and the Mouse.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的故事是《狮子和老鼠》。

lines.en: One day, a lion caught a little mouse.
lines.zh: 有一天，一头狮子抓住了一只小老鼠。

lines.en: The mouse said, "Please let me go, and I will help you one day."
lines.zh: 老鼠说：“请放了我吧，总有一天我会帮助你的。”

lines.en: The lion laughed, but he let the mouse go.
lines.zh: 狮子哈哈大笑，但还是放走了老鼠。

lines.en: Some days later, the lion was caught in a net.
lines.zh: 几天后，狮子被一张网困住了。

lines.en: He could not get out.
Then the little mouse cut the net with its teeth.
lines.zh: 这时，小老鼠用牙齿咬断了网。

lines.en: At last, the lion was free.
This story shows that small friends can be a great help.
lines.zh: 这个故事告诉我们，小小的朋友也能帮上大忙。

lines.en: I like it because even a little mouse can help a lion.
lines.zh: 我喜欢它，因为就连小老鼠也能帮助狮子。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I like this story because it is funny.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为它很有趣。

patterns.en: I like this story because the mouse is kind.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为老鼠很善良。

patterns.en: I like this story because the mouse is brave.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为老鼠很勇敢。

patterns.en: This story shows that small friends can be a great help.
patterns.zh: 这个故事告诉我们，小小的朋友也能帮上大忙。

patterns.en: I think the mouse is braver than the lion.
patterns.zh: 我觉得老鼠比狮子更勇敢。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
Today I want to share some ideas about making friends.
lines.zh: 今天我想和大家分享一些交朋友的想法。

lines.en: Last year, I came to a new school.
lines.zh: 去年，我来到了一所新学校。

lines.en: I had no friends, and I felt lonely.
lines.zh: 我一个朋友也没有，感到很孤单。

lines.en: Then a girl named Lily smiled at me and said hello.
lines.zh: 后来，一个叫莉莉的女孩笑着跟我打招呼。

lines.en: We started to play together after school.
lines.zh: 我们开始在放学后一起玩。

lines.en: Now she is my best friend.
lines.zh: 现在她是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: From her, I learned some things about making friends.
lines.zh: 从她身上，我学到了交朋友的一些道理。

lines.en: First, smile and say hello.
Second, listen to others and share with them.
lines.zh: 第二，倾听别人，和别人分享。

lines.en: Last, help your friends when they are in trouble.
lines.zh: 最后，朋友遇到困难时要帮助他们。

lines.en: If you are friendly, you will make many friends.
lines.zh: 如果你友好待人，就会交到很多朋友。

patterns.en: If you smile at others, you will make new friends.
patterns.zh: 如果你对别人微笑，就会交到新朋友。

patterns.en: If you share your toys, you will make new friends.
patterns.zh: 如果你分享你的玩具，就会交到新朋友。

patterns.en: If you listen to others, they will like you.
patterns.zh: 如果你倾听别人，他们就会喜欢你。

patterns.en: I think a good friend is someone who helps you.
patterns.zh: 我觉得好朋友就是会帮助你的人。

patterns.en: I think a kind friend is better than a lot of toys.
patterns.zh: 我觉得一个善良的朋友比很多玩具更好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Today I want to talk about learning English.
English is a very important language.
lines.zh: 英语是一门非常重要的语言。

lines.en: It is used all over the world.
At first, English was hard for me.
lines.zh: 一开始，英语对我来说很难。

lines.en: At school, I was afraid to speak.
lines.zh: 在学校里，我不敢开口说。

lines.en: Then my teacher had a talk with me.
She said, "Don't be afraid of mistakes."
Now I listen to English songs and read short stories every day.
lines.zh: 现在我每天听英语歌，读英语小故事。

lines.en: My friends and I talk in English after school.
lines.zh: 放学后，我和朋友们用英语聊天。

lines.en: My English is much better than before.
lines.zh: 我的英语比以前好多了。

lines.en: If you keep trying, you will learn English well.
lines.zh: 如果你坚持努力，就能学好英语。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I learn English by listening to songs.
patterns.zh: 我通过听歌学英语。

patterns.en: I learn English by reading stories.
patterns.zh: 我通过读故事学英语。

patterns.en: I learn English by watching cartoons.
patterns.zh: 我通过看动画片学英语。

patterns.en: If we practice every day, we will speak better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天练习，就会说得更好。

patterns.en: Speaking is harder than reading, but I like it.
patterns.zh: 说比读更难，但我很喜欢。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
Today I want to talk about a great invention.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈一项伟大的发明。

lines.en: It is paper.
Paper was first made in China a long time ago.
lines.zh: 很久以前，纸最早在中国被造出来。

lines.en: Before paper, people wrote on bones, wood or silk.
lines.zh: 在有纸之前，人们在骨头、木头或丝绸上写字。

lines.en: Bones and wood were heavy, and silk was very expensive.
lines.zh: 骨头和木头很重，丝绸又非常贵。

lines.en: Paper was lighter and cheaper.
So more people could read and write.
lines.zh: 所以更多的人能够读书写字了。

lines.en: Today we use paper every day.
lines.zh: 今天我们每天都在用纸。

lines.en: We use it for books, letters, money and pictures.
lines.zh: 我们用它来做书、信、钱和图画。

lines.en: I think paper is a really great invention.
lines.zh: 我觉得纸真是一项伟大的发明。

lines.en: But we should not waste it, because paper comes from trees.
lines.zh: 但我们不应该浪费纸，因为纸来自树木。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I think paper is a great invention because we use it every day.
patterns.zh: 我认为纸是一项伟大的发明，因为我们每天都用它。

patterns.en: I think the light bulb is a great invention because it lights up the night.
patterns.zh: 我认为电灯是一项伟大的发明，因为它照亮了黑夜。

patterns.en: I think the phone is a great invention because we can talk to friends far away.
patterns.zh: 我认为电话是一项伟大的发明，因为我们能和远方的朋友说话。

patterns.en: Paper is lighter than wood.
patterns.zh: 纸比木头轻。

patterns.en: Paper is cheaper than silk.
patterns.zh: 纸比丝绸便宜。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
The earth is our home, and we only have one.
lines.zh: 地球是我们的家园，而我们只有一个地球。

lines.en: But today, there is so much rubbish on the land and in the sea.
lines.zh: 但如今，陆地上和海洋里有那么多垃圾。

lines.en: Some fish and birds get ill because they eat plastic.
lines.zh: 一些鱼和鸟因为吃了塑料而生病。

lines.en: We need to keep our earth clean.
lines.zh: 我们需要保持地球清洁。

lines.en: What can we do?
First, we can put rubbish in the right bins.
lines.zh: 首先，我们可以把垃圾扔进正确的垃圾桶。

lines.en: Second, we can take our own bags when we go shopping.
lines.zh: 其次，购物时我们可以带上自己的袋子。

lines.en: Last, we can walk to school instead of going by car.
lines.zh: 最后，我们可以走路上学，而不是坐汽车。

lines.en: Last month, my friends and I cleaned up a park near our school.
lines.zh: 上个月，我和朋友们清扫了学校附近的一个公园。

lines.en: It was hard work, but the park looked much cleaner after that.
lines.zh: 那很辛苦，但之后公园看起来干净多了。

lines.en: If we all do a little, the earth will be a better place.
lines.zh: 如果我们每个人都出一份力，地球就会变得更美好。

lines.en: Let's work together!

patterns.en: If we put rubbish in bins, the earth will be cleaner.
patterns.zh: 如果我们把垃圾扔进垃圾桶，地球就会更干净。

patterns.en: If we plant trees, the air will be cleaner.
patterns.zh: 如果我们种树，空气就会更干净。

patterns.en: If we take our own bags, we will use less plastic.
patterns.zh: 如果我们自带袋子，就会少用塑料。

patterns.en: I think walking to school is better than going by car.
patterns.zh: 我觉得走路上学比坐汽车更好。

patterns.en: We should take our own bags when we go shopping.
patterns.zh: 购物时我们应该自带袋子。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
Do you use screens every day? I do!
lines.zh: 你每天都用屏幕吗？我是这样！

lines.en: Many children use phones every day.
lines.zh: 很多孩子每天都在用手机。

lines.en: Screens can be very useful.
We can learn new things and watch videos on them.
lines.zh: 我们可以用它们学习新知识、看视频。

lines.en: But too much screen time is bad for us.
lines.zh: 但是屏幕时间太长对我们有害。

lines.en: It is bad for our eyes, and we may not sleep well.
lines.zh: 它对我们的眼睛不好，我们也可能睡不好。

lines.en: And we have no time to play outside.
lines.zh: 而且我们没有时间去户外玩了。

lines.en: Last year, I played on my phone for hours every day.
lines.zh: 去年，我每天都要玩好几个小时手机。

lines.en: Now I only use it for half an hour a day.
lines.zh: 现在我每天只用半个小时。

lines.en: After school, I read books and play football.
I am stronger and happier than before.
lines.zh: 我比以前更强壮、更快乐了。

lines.en: Let's put down our phones and go outside!
lines.zh: 让我们放下手机，到户外去吧！

patterns.en: I think playing outside is better than playing on the phone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得在户外玩比玩手机更好。

patterns.en: I think reading a book is better than watching videos.
patterns.zh: 我觉得读书比看视频更好。

patterns.en: If we use screens too much, our eyes will get tired.
patterns.zh: 如果我们用屏幕太多，眼睛就会累。

patterns.en: If we go to bed early, we will feel better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们早点睡觉，就会感觉更好。

patterns.en: We should use screens for under an hour a day.
patterns.zh: 我们每天使用屏幕应该少于一个小时。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Today I want to tell you about a mistake I made.
lines.zh: 今天我想告诉大家我犯过的一个错误。

lines.en: Last winter, we had an important test.
lines.zh: 去年冬天，我们有一场重要的考试。

lines.en: I thought it was easy, so I did not get ready for it.
lines.zh: 我以为它很简单，所以没有好好准备。

lines.en: I played every night.
My mark was very low, and I was very sad.
lines.zh: 我的分数很低，我非常难过。

lines.en: I wanted to put the paper under my bed.
lines.zh: 我想把试卷藏到床底下。

lines.en: But at last, I told my mother the truth.
lines.zh: 但最后，我还是把实情告诉了妈妈。

lines.en: She was not angry at all.
She helped me make a plan.
lines.zh: 她帮我制订了一个计划。

lines.en: After that, I worked a little every day.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我每天都学一点。

lines.en: In the second test, I did much better.
lines.zh: 在第二次考试中，我考得好多了。

lines.en: Now I see that mistakes can help us grow.
lines.zh: 现在我明白了，错误可以帮助我们成长。

patterns.en: I did not get ready for the test, so I did badly.
patterns.zh: 我没有为考试做准备，所以考得很差。

patterns.en: I told the truth, so I felt better.
patterns.zh: 我说了实话，所以感觉好多了。

patterns.en: I worked hard every day, so I did much better.
patterns.zh: 我每天都努力学习，所以考得好多了。

patterns.en: I think telling the truth is better than keeping a secret.
patterns.zh: 我觉得说实话比藏着秘密更好。

patterns.en: If we learn from our mistakes, we will grow.
patterns.zh: 如果我们从错误中学习，就会成长。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
China has many great festivals.
lines.zh: 中国有很多很棒的节日。

lines.en: Let me talk about some of them.
lines.zh: 让我来介绍其中的几个。

lines.en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.
lines.zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。

lines.en: Families get together for a special meal.
lines.zh: 一家人团聚在一起，吃一顿特别的饭。

lines.en: We get red packets with money in them.
lines.zh: 我们会收到装着钱的红包。

lines.en: Then there is the Dragon Boat Festival.
We eat rice dumplings and watch the boat races.
lines.zh: 我们吃粽子，看龙舟比赛。

lines.en: After that comes the Mid-Autumn Festival.
On that night, the moon is round and bright.
lines.zh: 那天晚上，月亮又圆又亮。

lines.en: We eat mooncakes and look at the moon with our family.
lines.zh: 我们和家人一起吃月饼、赏月。

lines.en: I like the Spring Festival best, because I can see all my family.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢春节，因为我能见到全家人。

lines.en: Which festival do you like best?

patterns.en: I like the Spring Festival best because I can see all my family.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢春节，因为我能见到全家人。

patterns.en: I like the Dragon Boat Festival best because I love rice dumplings.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢端午节，因为我爱吃粽子。

patterns.en: I like the Mid-Autumn Festival best because the moon is beautiful.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢中秋节，因为月亮很美。

patterns.en: On the Mid-Autumn Festival, the moon is brighter than on other nights.
patterns.zh: 中秋节的月亮比其他夜晚更亮。

patterns.en: I think the Spring Festival is the most important festival.
patterns.zh: 我认为春节是最重要的节日。

title: A Trip I Want to Take

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Where do you want to go this summer?
Today I want to talk about a trip I want to take.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈我想去的一次旅行。

lines.en: This summer, I want to go to Beijing with my family.
lines.zh: 今年夏天，我想和家人一起去北京。

lines.en: Beijing has a long history, and it is very beautiful.
lines.zh: 北京历史悠久，而且非常美丽。

lines.en: First, I am going to climb the Great Wall.
It is longer than any other wall in the world.
lines.zh: 它比世界上任何一道墙都长。

lines.en: Then I will go to the Palace Museum.
lines.zh: 然后我会去故宫博物院。

lines.en: In the past, the emperors of China lived there.
lines.zh: 在过去，中国的皇帝住在那里。

lines.en: I want to try the food there, like Beijing duck.
lines.zh: 我想尝尝那里的美食，比如北京烤鸭。

lines.en: I will take many photos and send them to my friends.
lines.zh: 我会拍很多照片，发给我的朋友们。

lines.en: I think this will be a really great trip.
lines.zh: 我想这会是一次非常棒的旅行。

lines.en: I can't wait to go!
Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: I want to go to Beijing because I want to see the Great Wall.
patterns.zh: 我想去北京，因为我想看长城。

patterns.en: I want to go to the sea because I want to swim.
patterns.zh: 我想去海边，因为我想游泳。

patterns.en: I want to go to the north because I want to see the snow.
patterns.zh: 我想去北方，因为我想看雪。

patterns.en: When I get there, I am going to take many photos.
patterns.zh: 到了那里，我要拍很多照片。

patterns.en: The Great Wall is longer than any other wall in the world.
patterns.zh: 长城比世界上任何一道墙都长。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
Today I want to talk about teamwork.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈团队合作。

lines.en: Last month, we had a basketball match at school.
lines.zh: 上个月，我们在学校参加了一场篮球比赛。

lines.en: At first, we did not play well.
Everyone wanted to keep the ball.
lines.zh: 每个人都想自己拿着球。

lines.en: So we were behind.
At half time, our teacher said, "Play as a team!"
lines.zh: 中场休息时，老师说：“要像一个团队那样打球！”

lines.en: In the second half, we passed the ball to each other.
We helped each other and worked together.
lines.zh: 我们互相帮助，齐心协力。

lines.en: At last, we won the match!
I learned that a team is stronger than one person.
lines.zh: 我明白了，一个团队比一个人更强大。

lines.en: Together, we are stronger.
If we work together, we can do great things.
lines.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，就能做成大事。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.

patterns.en: If we work together, we will be stronger.
patterns.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，就会更强大。

patterns.en: If we help each other, we will do better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们互相帮助，就会做得更好。

patterns.en: If we talk to each other, we will be a better team.
patterns.zh: 如果我们互相交流，就会成为更好的团队。

patterns.en: A team is stronger than one person.
patterns.zh: 一个团队比一个人更强大。

patterns.en: I think working together is better than working alone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得一起合作比单独干更好。

lines.en: Dear teachers and friends, good morning.
lines.zh: 亲爱的老师们、同学们，早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to say thank you to our teachers.
lines.zh: 今天我想对我们的老师说声谢谢。

lines.en: Our teachers work very hard for us every day.
lines.zh: 我们的老师每天都为我们辛勤工作。

lines.en: They teach us how to read, write and think.
lines.zh: 他们教我们怎样读、怎样写、怎样思考。

lines.en: They help us to be good people.
lines.zh: 他们帮助我们成为好人。

lines.en: I still remember my first day at school.
lines.zh: 我还记得我上学的第一天。

lines.en: I was very sad, and I cried.
My first teacher held my hand and smiled at me.
lines.zh: 我的第一位老师拉着我的手，对我笑了笑。

lines.en: After that day, I loved school.
lines.zh: 从那天起，我爱上了学校。

lines.en: When I make mistakes, my teachers do not give up on me.
lines.zh: 当我犯错时，老师们不会放弃我。

lines.en: They say to me, "You can do it!"
Our teachers are like candles, giving light to others.
lines.zh: 我们的老师就像蜡烛，照亮别人。

lines.en: Thank you, dear teachers, for all your hard work.
lines.zh: 亲爱的老师们，谢谢你们的辛勤付出。

lines.en: We will work hard and make you proud.
lines.zh: 我们会努力学习，让你们为我们骄傲。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she is patient.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她很有耐心。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she helps me every day.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她每天都帮助我。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she makes school fun.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她让学校生活很有趣。

patterns.en: Thanks to my teacher, I am stronger than before.
patterns.zh: 多亏了我的老师，我比以前更坚强了。

patterns.en: If we work hard in school, our teachers will be happy.
patterns.zh: 如果我们在学校努力学习，老师们就会很高兴。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
Time goes so quickly, and this school year is almost over.
lines.zh: 时间过得真快，这个学年快要结束了。

lines.en: Today I want to look back on this year.
lines.zh: 今天我想回顾一下这一年。

lines.en: This year, I learned many new things.
lines.zh: 这一年，我学到了很多新东西。

lines.en: My English is much better than last year.
lines.zh: 我的英语比去年好多了。

lines.en: Now I can give a short talk in English.
lines.zh: 现在我能用英语做一个简短的演讲了。

lines.en: I made new friends and joined the art club.
lines.zh: 我交了新朋友，还参加了美术社团。

lines.en: Some days were hard for me.
lines.zh: 有些日子对我来说很难熬。

lines.en: I lost a race on Sports Day, and I was very sad.
lines.zh: 我在运动会上输了一场赛跑，非常难过。

lines.en: But I did not give up, and I kept running every morning.
lines.zh: 但我没有放弃，每天早上都坚持跑步。

lines.en: These things made me stronger and braver.
lines.zh: 这些经历让我变得更强大、更勇敢。

lines.en: Next year, I am going to read more books and help others.
lines.zh: 明年，我要读更多的书，并且帮助别人。

lines.en: I think next year will be even better.
Thank you all for a happy year!
lines.zh: 谢谢大家陪我度过快乐的一年！

patterns.en: This year, I learned to swim, and I am happy about it.
patterns.zh: 这一年，我学会了游泳，我为此感到高兴。

patterns.en: My English is better than last year.
patterns.zh: 我的英语比去年更好了。

patterns.en: I am braver than before because I did not give up.
patterns.zh: 我比以前更勇敢了，因为我没有放弃。

patterns.en: Next year, I am going to read more books.
patterns.zh: 明年，我要读更多的书。

patterns.en: If I keep working hard, next year will be even better.
patterns.zh: 如果我继续努力，明年会更好。
